decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains a good strategic fit with our specialist, standards-driven business and its long procurement cycles mean the option still has value while market evidence continues to emerge.

The spring-balanced desk lamp is comparatively peripheral and more exposed to competitive, lower-differentiation markets, so after two years we would reallocate resources unless it had shown clearly stronger traction.

A general interior luminaire sits in the center of our established offering, and with no strong signal of failure the low-cost option is to keep it in the portfolio and continue harvesting learning and sales.

Marine searchlights still match our robust transport and specialist-lighting capabilities, and after pruning the adjacent HMI variant it is efficient to keep this remaining option open while demand in the niche becomes clearer.
